mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months, it signals tightening monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 6.5%), a rising labor force (PAYEMS growth > 0.2% monthly) signals sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months meeting the trigger condition (UNRATE < 6.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.2%).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output, correlating with improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of months, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate revenue, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST exceeds 1000 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 110), a concurrent rise in GDP (GDPC1) above its 4-quarter moving average signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months meeting the trigger condition (INDPRO > 110 and GDPC1 > 4QMA(GDPC1)).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, reducing capital costs and increasing consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
